newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industry soars 9.7 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industry soars 9.7 pct in September.

text.p: Romanian industrial output rose by 9.7 percent in September, recovering from a 1.2 percent slide in August, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Monday.
The CNS said industrial production was 6.6 trillion lei in September, while the nine-month output stood at 47.9 trillion lei, or 8.7 percent up from the year-ago period.
Some 19 percent of January-September output went to export, almost unchanged from the same period last year.

Manufacturing industry output surged by 10.9 percent over January-September from the same period a year ago, while output in the power sector rose by 5.2 percent. The extractive industry saw a 0.9 percent drop.
Productivity per hour rose by 4.6 percent last month from August and by 12.1 percent year-on-year.
Industry employed 2.222 million people at end-September, 6,700 less than the begining of the month.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95
NOTE: Figures were adjusted for differnet number of working days. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
